data.name: AlFani

data.long_meaning: One who possesses wisdom and knowledge. data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of AlFani total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
